description: HTTP fetch / GET any URL: exactly what the server sent, status code, headers and body, plus the final URL after redirects. Every status is a result, so a 404 or 500 from the target is delivered, not failed. Use it for API checks, uptime probes and raw HTML. Input: url. Readable text from a rendered page: extract.page. $0.10 per call. Returns: url, final_url, status, content_type, bytes, text, truncated, headers{}.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_fetch_raw
title: Raw HTTP fetch
